trainers.finishSound: Great, you sorted all the animals by size.

instruction.sound: We want to sort these animals according to their size. First, colour in the smallest animal purple.

instruction.text: Colour in the next largest animal <m-green>green</m-green>.
instruction.sound: Exactly, the ant is the smallest animal here! Which animal is the next biggest animal after the ant? Colour it in green.

instruction.text: Colour in the next largest animal <m-blue>blue</m-blue>.
instruction.sound: Well done, the pigeon is the next biggest animal after the ant. And which animal comes next? Colour it in blue.
The wild boar is the next biggest, great job. Finally, which animal is the biggest here? Colour it in orange.

trainers.finishSound: All done, you coloured in the vehicles correctly.

instruction.sound: Now you should sort these four vehicles according to their size. First colour-in the smallest vehicle purple.

instruction.text: Colour in the next largest vehicle <m-green>green</m-green>.
instruction.sound: Correct, the children’s bike is the smallest. What is the next biggest one? Colour it in green.

instruction.text: Colour in the next largest vehicle <m-blue>blue</m-blue>.
instruction.sound: Great. Which vehicle comes next? Colour it in blue.
Exactly, the digger! Now colour-in the largest vehicle orange.
